<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Introducing The Kitesurfers Villa!</h2><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Nestled in the heart of Punta Chame, Panama, the kitesurfers villa and home of Ronja &amp; Brendan offers a tranquil escape just 150 meters from our Kite house and 50 meters from the beach. Perfect for unwinding between kite sessions, guests have full access to all of the Panama Kite House facilities and equipment storage.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">With four cozy guest rooms in the villa, you'll find comfort in every corner. Surrounded by a tropical garden with an incredible range of tropical plants an wildlife. The large pool and hot tub are prefect to relax after a long session. We also have a floodlit tennis, pickle ball court plus a ping pong area, there's plenty to enjoy. </p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our massage therapist can also offer massage on site at the villa.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Choose from Bed &amp; Breakfast, Half Board, or Full Board packages, catering to families, digital nomads, groups, couples, and solo travelers alike. <br>All meals are being served at the Panama Kite House.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">The Kitesurfers Villa is the perfect place to have exclusive access to the Panama Kite House and its facilities, but at the same time providing a bit more privacy and quite space.</p>
</div>
